helpIntro: Drexel uses a 4.0 scale with A+ and A both worth 4.00. Enter Drexel credits and finalized undergraduate grades to estimate your current and projected GPA.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate GPA. Drexel reports GPA to two decimal places without rounding up; this shared calculator displays three decimals for planning. Repeat GPA adjustments require an approved petition, so Repeat Impact is not automated.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16 grade points and a 3-credit B- earns 8.01. Together, 24.01 ÷ 7 = 3.430.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 points; GPA-bearing credits still count in the denominator.
gradeExplanations.I/F: Administrative incomplete/failure is reflected in GPA as a failure when posted.
gradeExplanations.N/F: Unresolved GNS that converts to N/F is calculated as a failure.
gradeExplanations.AU: Audit designation does not enter GPA.
gradeExplanations.INC: Incomplete is excluded until resolved; it can later become I/F.
gradeExplanations.CR: Credit/No Credit CR does not affect term or cumulative GPA.
gradeExplanations.NCR: Credit/No Credit NCR does not affect term or cumulative GPA.
gradeExplanations.GNS: Grade Not Submitted is temporary; use the final grade once posted.

specialTypes.name: Drexel course, standard letter grading
specialTypes.note: Use for finalized undergraduate Drexel letter grades, including approved credit-by-exam grades.

specialTypes.name: External transfer or advanced-placement credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer/AP credit can count toward degree progress but external grades do not enter the Drexel GPA.

specialTypes.name: Drexel-sponsored exchange course (CR/NCR)
specialTypes.note: Exchange courses recorded CR/NCR do not factor into the Drexel GPA.

specialTypes.name: Graduate, Law, or other separately governed record
specialTypes.note: This profile is undergraduate only; use the rules for the applicable academic record.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is not automated. Drexel repeats normally remain in GPA unless an eligible undergraduate GPA-adjustment petition is approved; use your official adjusted GPA after Drexel processes it.
